stdout:
name: changelog-landing

on:
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: [main]

concurrency:
  group: changelog-landing-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  verify:
    runs-on: [self-hosted, Windows, X64, regression-research]
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Run deterministic changed-area verification
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $event = "${{ github.event_name }}"
          $ref = "${{ github.ref }}"
          if ($event -eq "pull_request") {
            $base = "origin/${{ github.base_ref }}"
          } elseif ($event -eq "push" -and $ref -eq "refs/heads/main") {
            $base = "HEAD^"
          } else {
            $base = "origin/main"
          }
          python tools/verify.py --base-ref $base
